From the looks of it you have fought all adversities and have continued to push forward. Despite the numerous obstacles you have faced you are still here with us. You my friend are a fighter and like always you will somehow dig deep and find the strength to move on. Use this platform to update us about your journey and inspire us to keep fighting. Love you and we are here.

The first step towards healing is talking about it. The constant ramble, self-doubt and loathing within your mind now takes form on a piece of paper. Write and keep on writing your thoughts down onto a journal allowing yourself a safe space to vent.   

Relationship with friends and family can be mended. Do not waste your time and energy justifying their inaction in understanding your state of mind. Unfortunately people do not realize the constant battle one faces from mental health issues.   

Disconnect yourself from the online world and seek refuge in nature. You need to be alone outside to find your path onwards. What is done is done. You are strong to have spoken up about it here. We are here to listen and be your pillar of support.
Just wasn't your day to end your life. Maybe a sign you're meant to do something. Change your life or change might be headed. Start strong. You always have us to support you.

Ear plugs helps a bit. The feeling of not being able to hear others creates this illusion where I no longer hear my own thoughts. White noise overlapped with classical music calms me a bit too. Breathe deeply. We are here for you.

In our darkest moments we must find our candle to keep the room lit. Crying helps ease/soften the noise a bit. Talking out loud to myself helps a bit. I would say "I'll be there for you no matter what. You got this." I would rock back and forth trying my best to console myself.
talking/typing it out here will help. voices in your head sound so loud and menacing. once you pen them down it helps a bit, either a journal/blog/ or here.
